combo_label: London Underground × Chocolate & Sweets × Mr Men & Little Miss

entries.clue: Grown as a green herb, its cooling flavour fills thin after-dinner chocolates
Sold by weight, a self-chosen bagful of many different sweets
Printed slip that admits you to a cinema or a football match
Comfortably barrel-shaped, or full and sonorous of voice
Gibberish; also the sort of verse Edward Lear made his name with
Worker who heads into town each morning and home each night
Amusing in one reading, distinctly peculiar in the other
Oats bound with syrup and baked into a bar, often finished with chocolate
Fare ring — the middle of London is number one
Almost black by-product of refining cane, thick and faintly bitter
Barging past without so much as a sorry, and proud of it
Chart of departures, hour by hour, for every service of the day
Blessed by four-leaf clover and a horseshoe nailed above the door
